Is there an unbiased game review site?

That depends on what you mean by "unbiased"- by their very nature, reviews are biased either in favor or against the things that are being reviewed.

If you mean politically unbiased, I can definitely see the challenge in finding a review site that doesn't consider the politics of a game- if you mean unbiased from a business standpoint, what you'll want to look for is a site that very clearly discloses where its money is coming from- hopefully they're not reviewing the games that are paying to put ads on their site!

Speaking as a game journalist, I have biases of my own- I don't like brutal violence, for instance. Generally speaking, I don't play or review games that contain it- that said, I try not to be cagey or secretive about my biases. I wear them on my sleeve- I think that's the best thing you can ask for out of a critic- somebody who has biases, but is straightforward about what they are and how they affect coverage.

I hope you find what you're looking for out of a game review site!
